name: Nightmäre
source:
The Magician of March / The Nightmare Magician

A being who watches over the nightmare side of the dream world. The veil darkens/blacks out when Nightmäre loses control of their powers, their face morphing into a monster's. Because of this, Nightmäre has a fear of mirrors and being looked at despite living in a hidden dimension with no other people.

Nightmäre is anxious and prone to hallucinations, but still wishes the best for humankind with the little clarity they have left. They seem to have some kind of relation with the Nightmare monsters that plague the August worlds.

[From [url=https://toyhou.se/12607463.nightm-re]official bio[/url]]
